note: 미션 클리어 이미지 정의. tiers 순서 = 파일 번호(0 클리어, 1 전투, 2 도발, 3 고자극). groups에 묶음별 연출 지시와 분위기를 적는다. 미션의 scenes가 비어 있으면 beat(미션 요약) + 묶음의 단계 지시로 프롬프트를 만든다. 로맨틱은 4단계 대신 요원별 '그날 밤' 6컷(n_<요원>_<1..6>.jpg)으로 바뀌어 nights에 정의한다(현재는 ChatGPT 프롬프트 전용).
style: Semi-realistic anime illustration, cinematic lighting, rich detail, the same art style as the reference images. Vertical 2:3 composition. Every face fully visible and unobstructed, heads in the upper half of the frame with clear space above the hair. No text, no logo, no watermark.

missions.title: 혼자 남은 사람
missions.place: Harbor warehouse no. 3 at night, stacked shipping containers, sodium lamps, wet concrete, sea fog.
scenes: She walks out of the warehouse door at dawn, the freed hostage a blurred silhouette behind her, glancing back over her shoulder.
She takes down a masked guard from behind between the containers, red scarf whipping in the air.
She sits on a shipping crate by the pier, jacket unzipped low, pulling the red scarf down from her lips with a smirk, harbor lights behind.
A small safehouse room above the harbor at dawn. She leans on the window frame in black lace lingerie with the red scarf still around her neck, her gear dropped on the floor.

missions.title: 원거리 지원
missions.place: A mountain road checkpoint at night, pine forest, a watchtower and a radio mast, cold mist.
scenes: The two walk away side by side from the dead radio mast, the sniper carrying her rifle on her shoulder, the leader with a hand on her knife.
The sniper lies prone taking the shot at the watchtower while the leader crouches beside her calling the wind, muzzle flash and drifting mist.
Both lean against a parked off-road vehicle on the mountain road, jackets open, one fixing the other's collar, both looking at the viewer with teasing smiles.
A mountain cabin by a fireplace. Both in lace lingerie under one shared blanket, the rifle resting against the wall, warm firelight.

missions.title: 눈이 되는 자
missions.place: A corporate front office at night, glass walls, a cold blue server room, dead CCTV monitors.
scenes: Inside the elevator on the way out, the hacker holds up a data drive with a grin while the leader stands with arms crossed.
The hacker kills the cameras from a tablet as her drone hovers, the leader slipping through the server racks with a knife, screens going black one by one.
The dark executive office. The hacker sits on the CEO's desk with legs crossed and glasses pushed up, the leader leaning on the desk beside her, shirts loosened.
A high-floor hotel room, city neon through the window. Both in lingerie, the hacker with headphones still around her neck, the leader with her red scarf, laptops forgotten on the bed.

missions.title: 길을 내는 자
missions.place: An abandoned mine, timber-braced tunnels, an armory deep inside, dust in lamp light.
scenes: The two walk out of the mine mouth into morning light, dusted grey, the breacher with a sledge on her shoulder, the sniper slinging her rifle.
The breacher smashes through a cracked wall in a burst of rubble while the sniper covers the tunnel with her rifle, debris frozen mid-air.
Sitting on ammunition crates in the armory, tank tops and unzipped suits, wiping dust off each other, grinning at the viewer.
A mountain hot spring at night after the job. Both in swimsuits in rising steam, towels on the rocks, lantern light.

missions.title: 가면 무도회
missions.place: A patron's mansion during a masquerade ball, chandeliers, a grand staircase, a study with a hidden safe.
scenes: The two descend the grand staircase leaving the party, masks in hand, the ledger tucked under an arm, exchanging a look.
In the study, the infiltrator in an evening gown and mask opens the safe while the hacker crouches under the desk with a laptop, a guard's shadow at the door.
On the ballroom balcony, the infiltrator lifts her mask with a knowing smile, gown slit showing her leg, the hacker beside her in a loosened waiter vest.
The mansion's powder room, gilded mirrors and candlelight. Both in lace lingerie still wearing their masquerade masks, champagne glasses in hand.

missions.title: 마지막 한 명
missions.place: An isolation ward of a private hospital at night, long white corridors, red emergency lights.
scenes: The two support a wounded informant, seen from behind, down the corridor toward the exit, both looking forward, steady.
The medic fires a tranquilizer dart down the corridor as the leader covers her flank with a knife, red emergency light and falling guards.
An empty ward room after the fight. The medic sits on the bed edge with her coat open, the leader leans in the doorway with scarf loosened, both eyeing the viewer.
A safehouse at night. The medic in lingerie under an open white coat bandages the leader's shoulder, the leader in lingerie with her red scarf, a tender close moment.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 1 · 첫 번째 상자
missions.place: 18:40. A snowy city-hall square Christmas market at dusk: rows of wooden stalls with string lights, a giant decorated tree, a carousel, crowds as soft blurred silhouettes.
missions.beat: She goes in alone among the crowd to lift Santa's delivery list hidden under the giant tree. Civilians everywhere, so nobody dies tonight.
scenes: She walks out of the market through falling snow with a small ribbon-tied box under her arm, glancing back at the glowing tree.
Behind the stalls, in the dark service lane, she chokes out a fake shopper in a Santa hat, string lights blurred behind them, red scarf flying.
Leaning on a closed stall counter with a cup of mulled wine, winter jacket open, she pulls the red scarf down and smirks at the viewer, carousel lights spinning behind.
A small attic room above the square, fairy lights in the window. She sits on the sill in red-and-black lace lingerie with the scarf loose around her neck, the stolen box unopened beside her.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 2 · 화차 44호
missions.place: 20:10. A freight rail yard at night in snow: long lines of boxcars on parallel tracks, two floodlight towers, a signal cabin, steam and frost.
missions.beat: Find the marked boxcar among dozens, kill the floodlights, breach the car wall and blow Santa's crates.
scenes: The two walk down the track away from a burning boxcar, the breacher with a sledge on her shoulder, the hacker flipping a detonator switch closed.
The floodlights die as the hacker's drone sparks; in the sudden dark the breacher smashes through the boxcar wall in a burst of splinters and snow.
Sitting in an open boxcar door with legs dangling, jackets open over tank tops, sharing a thermos, both grinning at the viewer, sparks drifting past.
Inside a warm caboose with a small iron stove. Both in festive red-and-white lingerie with fur trim, the hacker in a Santa hat, the breacher warming her taped hands at the stove.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 3 · 얼음 위의 선물
missions.place: 22:30. A vast frozen lake under moonlight: ice-fishing huts, a long pier, a boathouse, a lodge and a birch forest on the shore, gusts of blowing snow.
missions.beat: A witness is being held in the boathouse as tonight's 'gift'. Cross the open ice under cover of the blizzard, one shot only, and bring him out alive.
scenes: On the shore at the forest edge, the medic supports a rescued man wrapped in a blanket, seen from behind, while the sniper covers the lake with her rifle.
The sniper lies prone on the ice in white camouflage taking a single shot through blowing snow while the medic sprints low toward the boathouse with her dart pistol.
Inside an ice-fishing hut by a lantern, both with parkas open, the sniper blowing on her fingers, the medic holding out a flask toward the viewer with a wink.
The lodge sauna room after the mission, steam and cedar wood. Both wrapped in white towels, hair damp, the sniper's rifle propped by the door, snow at the window.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 4 · 자정 미사
missions.place: 00:00. A grand cathedral at midnight mass: long rows of pews, stone pillars, hundreds of candles, a choir loft, an altar, bells ringing in the tower.
missions.beat: Swap the money bag in the offering box behind the altar for one with a tracker, during the midnight bells, without touching a single guard.
scenes: The two leave by the side door into the snow, the infiltrator in a choir robe carrying the swapped bag, the leader holding the heavy door, bells above them.
In the candlelit nave the infiltrator glides past a guard in her choir robe while the leader crouches between the pews in shadow, knife ready, as the great bell swings.
Up in the bell tower stairs, the infiltrator has the choir robe slipping off her shoulders over an evening dress, the leader leans on the stone wall, both looking down at the viewer.
A candlelit room in the old rectory. Both in black lace lingerie, the infiltrator with a red ribbon at her throat, the leader with her scarf, candles and frost on the leaded window.

missions.title: 블러디 크리스마스 5 · 산타의 썰매
missions.place: 03:30. A private airfield in heavy snow: a lit runway, a hangar with a private jet, a control tower with a slow searchlight, fuel trucks and a snowplow.
missions.beat: Reach the jet before it takes off and seize Santa's cargo. Inside there is only an empty ribbon-tied box and a card addressed to them.
scenes: The three stand on the runway at dawn as the grounded jet sits behind them, the leader holding an empty ribbon-tied box and a card, snow easing.
Runway lights streak past: the leader sprints for the open hangar, the sniper fires from the top of a snowplow, the hacker crouches with her drone as the searchlight freezes.
Inside the jet's cabin, the three lounge across the leather seats with flight jackets open, the hacker wearing the pilot's cap, champagne from the galley, all looking at the viewer.
A hotel suite at Christmas dawn with a lit tree. All three in red-and-white festive lingerie with fur trim, the empty gift box open on the bed between them, soft morning light.

nights.mood: Tone: the night swings back and forth between ROMANTIC cuts and EROTIC cuts, and the contrast is the point. The viewer is the handler she trusts; every cut is seen through his eyes and he is never shown (at most the edge of a hand, a tie, a shoulder). ROMANTIC cuts: quiet, unguarded, soft practical light, a held gaze, small gestures, real feeling. EROTIC cuts: voluptuous, seductive and bold. Low light, glistening skin, lingerie-level or swimsuit-level outfits, clinging fabric, a direct inviting look, a pose that knows exactly what it is doing. Shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, cinematic color. The heat is in the pose, the gaze and the styling; everything beyond that is implied, never shown.

raven.title: 스카프를 푸는 밤
raven.place: A small safehouse room above the harbor, rain on the window, one warm lamp.
cuts: ARRIVAL. She comes in through the door still in her mission gear, tired, and finds the viewer waiting. Relief crosses her face.
UNWINDING. She puts the night down piece by piece: gear off, she finally unties the red scarf she has worn for three years and holds it out toward the viewer.
QUIET TALK. Sitting close with a drink, knees almost touching, she tells what happened tonight. She has just learned that her teammate chose to stay behind; the guilt she carried is loosening.
CLOSING THE DISTANCE. She leans in toward the camera, one hand reaching for the viewer, outer layer gone, a camisole or loose shirt, a look that asks a question.
THE NIGHT. Lamp-lit bed or sofa, lingerie-level sleepwear or an oversized shirt, sheets and shadow doing the covering. She lies close, eyes on the viewer. Tender, slow, implied intimacy only.

MORNING AFTER. First light through the window, she is wrapped in a sheet or the viewer's shirt, hair loose, a soft unguarded smile. The red scarf lies folded on the bedside table; she is not wearing it. Match the mood of the ending reference image.

viper.title: 설산 노천탕
viper.place: A mountain lodge with an outdoor hot spring in deep snow, then its fire-lit room. Night, falling snow, rising steam.
cuts: EROTIC. She is already in the steaming outdoor bath, back to the viewer, hair pinned up, a black bikini, snow falling on her bare shoulders. She looks over her shoulder with a cool stare and curls one finger: come here.
ROMANTIC. Close on her face in the steam. Her wet hand rests flat on the viewer's chest as she counts his breathing the way a sniper does, eyes calm and soft for once.
EROTIC. She rises out of the water, a thin white bath robe clinging wet to her figure, steam curling off her skin, the cold gaze turned hot. Water runs down her collarbone.
ROMANTIC. Inside by the fire, robe loose off one shoulder, she dries her hair and places a single unspent rifle round in the viewer's open palm: the shot she chose not to take.
EROTIC. On a fur rug before the fireplace, robe open over black lace lingerie, lying on her side with a steady sniper's stare, one hand hooked in the viewer's collar pulling him down.
ROMANTIC. Blue dawn through the big window. She sleeps against the viewer's shoulder under a blanket, the rifle left by the door for the first time, snow light on her face.

glitch.title: 화면 속과 화면 밖
glitch.place: Her small apartment full of monitors and LED strips, neon from the street below. Teal and magenta light.
cuts: EROTIC. Framed as a video call on a screen, with glitch artifacts at the edges: she sits back in her chair in an oversized hoodie slipping off one shoulder, bare legs up on the desk, tongue out, headphones on. A dare to come over.
ROMANTIC. The door. She pulls the viewer by the wrist into the dark room lit only by monitors, glasses crooked, a shy real smile she was not ready to show.

EROTIC. Perched on the desk among keyboards, hoodie unzipped over a neon-teal lace bralette and short shorts, legs crossed toward the viewer, a headphone cable wound around one finger. Decadent neon on her skin.
ROMANTIC. She turns the screens off one by one. In the glow of the last laptop she types her real name, turns the screen toward the viewer and waits, small and honest.

EROTIC. On the bed under an LED strip, lying upside down with her hair spilling over the edge, a teal lingerie set and thigh-high socks, looking at the viewer upside down, one arm reaching up for him.
ROMANTIC. Morning, every screen dark. She sits at the window in the viewer's shirt with a mug, typing lazily, and looks back over her shoulder with a sleepy grin.

brick.title: 문 닫은 체육관
brick.place: A boxing gym after closing: a ring, heavy bags, a locker room, then the rooftop. Warm tungsten light, sweat and chalk in the air.
cuts: ROMANTIC. She closes the gym door quietly, for once, and hangs four dog tags on the ring post, touching them with two fingers.
EROTIC. At the heavy bag in a sports bra and shorts, taped fists, skin glistening with sweat, every muscle lit from the side. Between punches she glances at the viewer and grins.
EROTIC. In the ring she has the viewer backed against the ropes: one arm braced on the top rope beside his head, face inches away, breathing hard, a slow daring smile.
ROMANTIC. Sitting on the ring apron, she holds out her hands and lets the viewer unwrap the tape. Bruised knuckles, quiet eyes, shoulders finally dropped.
EROTIC. The locker room, steam from the showers. Wrapped in a single towel, wet hair down, leaning back against the lockers, she tugs the towel around the viewer's neck to pull him closer.
ROMANTIC. Sunrise on the gym roof. She sits in an oversized hoodie sharing one blanket, head on the viewer's shoulder, the city waking below.

mirage.title: 호텔 스위트, 가면을 벗는 밤
mirage.place: A grand hotel: the bar, the mirrored elevator, then a suite with a vanity and floor-to-ceiling windows over the city. Gold light and deep shadow.
cuts: EROTIC. At the hotel bar in a backless black gown, she slides a room key card across the counter with a gloved fingertip, lips at the rim of her glass, eyes never leaving the viewer.
EROTIC. The mirrored elevator. She touches up her lipstick while watching the viewer through the mirror, gown slit open along her leg, her other hand trailing down his tie.
ROMANTIC. At the suite's vanity she takes off the earrings, the gloves and the makeup. Her own bare face looks out of the mirror, asking to be seen without a role.
EROTIC. By the window, a silk robe sliding off both shoulders over black lace lingerie and stockings, champagne in hand, the city glittering behind her. Decadent and unhurried.
ROMANTIC. On satin sheets in the same lingerie, lying on her stomach with her chin on her hands and her feet in the air, bare-faced, laughing for real.
ROMANTIC. Morning on the balcony in the viewer's white shirt, no makeup, no jewelry, coffee in both hands, nothing performed.

doc.title: 진료 시간 종료
doc.place: A small clinic after hours and the room behind it: an exam table, a desk lamp, plants on the sill. Warm lamp light with a lime-green accent.
cuts: EROTIC. She locks the clinic door and flips the sign to CLOSED. White coat over a fitted dress, she snaps on one glove and smirks at the viewer: your turn for a checkup.
ROMANTIC. But first she holds out her scraped knuckles and, for once, lets someone else do the bandaging. A tired, grateful smile.
EROTIC. Sitting on the exam table, coat off her shoulders, blouse open over a lime-green lace top, she presses the stethoscope to the viewer's chest and leans in close to listen, eyes up at him.
ROMANTIC. Among the plants on the windowsill she waters them under the lamp and talks about the senior medic who walked out on his own feet. The chart lies closed on the desk.
EROTIC. Her room behind the clinic. A lime-green silk slip, stethoscope still around her neck, lying back on the bed with one tattooed arm above her head and the other hand beckoning.
ROMANTIC. Morning. Two coffee cups on the desk; she sits in the viewer's shirt writing one word at the bottom of the chart, 'discharged', and smiles up.

maps.common: Top-down three-quarter (isometric quarter view) painted game map, 1536x1024, the whole area visible at once, clear readable walkable ground and solid obstacles, consistent scale, no characters, no text, no UI. Painterly but clean edges so that cover objects are easy to tell from open ground.

items.desc: A snowy city-hall square Christmas market at dusk. Four rows of wooden stalls forming narrow alleys, a giant decorated tree in the center, a carousel on one side, a fountain and a small stage at the edges, dark service lanes behind the stalls. Bright warm string lights in the center, dark blue shadow at the edges.

A freight rail yard at night in snow. Five parallel tracks running left to right with long lines of boxcars and gaps between cars, stacked containers, two tall floodlight towers at the ends casting wide circles of light, a signal cabin in the middle. Very wide layout.

A vast frozen lake at night under moonlight. Open ice across half the image with a few ice-fishing huts and sled piles, a long wooden pier, a boathouse, a lodge on the shore and a dense birch forest along one edge. Wide and empty, wind-blown snow streaks on the ice.

The interior of a grand cathedral at midnight, roof removed for the top-down view. Two long rows of pews down the nave, stone pillars, side aisles with confessional booths, an altar with an offering box, a choir loft, a bell-tower stair and a crypt entrance. Hundreds of candles, warm light near the altar, cold stone elsewhere.

A private airfield in heavy snow before dawn. A lit runway and taxiway, an open hangar with a private jet inside, a control tower, two fuel trucks and a snowplow, snowbanks along the runway edge, a chain-link fence and open snowfield beyond. Runway edge lights in rows.
